verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Blink supports Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys on a libssh/libssh2 base. The docs also document the `ssh [user@]hostname` workflow, SSH key-pair creation for password-less access, and installing keys via ssh-copy-id. Community users report solid connectivity, though not specifically by key type. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that each key type (Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA) works in practice.
